what: Inside the big English section-name letters, a gradient of background color → beige → accent color (120°, 1%·56%·100%) is laid at 200% width, so at first it blends into the background and is nearly invisible. Once the heading reaches 50% of the screen it slides once to the end in .5s with no curve, turning from beige to orange

options.start: Trigger point (ScrollTrigger start), default “top 50%” — the original’s Culture section uses “bottom bottom”
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name, four numbers), default none
options.--fx-from · --fx-mid · --fx-to · --fx-an: Gradient three colors and angle (via style), defaults --kf-bg · --kf-raised (accent mixed 22%) · --kf-accent · 120deg — on an orange panel, set --fx-to to --kf-on-accent
options.look: duo: Two colors only — linear-gradient(--fx-angle default 114deg, --fx-from default --kf-bg 24%, --fx-to default --kf-ink 65%) at 300% width (the towa section name). Positions are --fx-at-from · --fx-at-to.
options.size: Gradient width (%), default 200 (300 for duo type)
options.reverse: At 1 it pushes from 100% → 0% (colors in from right to left)
options.on: ”load” runs right on attach after the delay without waiting for scroll — the big hero headline
options.look: diag: For text blocks (multi-line body, big sentences) — lays a -45° gradient from transparent 60% → text color (--fx-to, default --kf-ink) 80% at 1000% width and height and slides it from 80% 80% → 0% 0%, so the text is revealed starting where the diagonal band has swept past. Position is --fx-at-from · --fx-at-to, size is size (default 1000), width stays as is (width: auto)

from.where: shared.css .an-title (section name on every page — original Ws: 200% from 0%→100% .5s none, once, top 50%)
from.options: Default · culture section start: bottom bottom · company/careers panel style: --fx-to: var(--kf-on-accent)
